projects.title: The Sandars – Phase 1, 2, & 3
projects.summary: A multi‑phase gated village set within 27 acres of Surrey parkland and lakes that blends Grade II listed heritage with contemporary design to provide bespoke 1- and 2‑bedroom apartments for residents over 55.
projects.highlights: Restoration of Eastley End House; social hub at Cullinan House; focus on wellness, community, quality and long‑term security.

projects.title: Beatties
projects.summary: Redevelopment of an iconic former department store preserving the 1877 Art Deco façade and converting the site into a vibrant mixed‑use destination with over 300 dwellings and commercial activation.
projects.highlights: Retention of existing building fabric to minimize carbon impact; creation of public realms including Parkland Walk and Courtyard Gardens; reinstatement of the original arcade to improve urban permeability.

projects.title: Ingestre Road Residential Assisted Living
projects.summary: A flagship assisted living scheme transforming underutilised urban space into high‑quality residential environments that prioritize architectural quality, resident dignity, and community green spaces.
projects.highlights: Design influenced by local modernist heritage using dark brick and articulated rooflines; integration of Lifetime Homes principles and vibrant community green spaces.

projects.title: Brockley Hill Care Home & Heritage Regeneration
projects.summary: Sensitive regeneration of a derelict site formerly part of the Royal National Orthopaedic Hospital, balancing preservation of heritage assets with delivery of modern care facilities and enhanced natural landscapes.
projects.highlights: Preservation of East Gate Lodge and Vine Cottage; project sits over a Scheduled Ancient Monument requiring careful planning; outcome provides modern care environments and community amenities.
